context.body: John’s Gospel presents testimony under interrogation rather than narrating Jesus entering the water.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: John tells Jerusalem’s delegation that he is not the Christ, Elijah, or the prophet, then identifies himself with Isaiah’s voice.
observations.label: John denies three identities and names a present unknown one: action

observations.body: He explains his water baptism by pointing to one already standing among them.
observations.label: John denies three identities and names a present unknown one: response

observations.body: not the Christ · not Elijah · voice · water · among you
observations.label: Words in John 1:19–28

payload.posture: Read John 1:19–28 as john prepares the way evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: John’s denial that he is Elijah stands beside other Gospel language linking him to Elijah’s role.
payload.title: John denies three identities and names a present unknown one
